user_saw: When users alternated between channel messages and web chat in the same Claude CLI session, replies could continue from stale history and miss recent turns.
summary: The fix gives each Claude CLI conversation one warm process and queue slot, retires incompatible processes before resuming, and limits standing approvals to the activated turn.
reasoning: The Gateway reproduction showed two warm processes resuming the same native session and creating four stale-parent forks. I verified that the account- and auth-scoped keys predated the shallow boundary and survived both the Agent SDK and direct CLI transport refactors. The offline history could not resolve the older introducing diff, and I found no later change that established when cross-route continuity first failed.
